test_title: PYST 9: SSC CGL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 11 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Four letter-clusters have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the one that is

different.

Note : The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter cluster
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) ONM

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4880bd57ce5a49aeefe2291f7428f294b148742a2b57648f2088bd1752a8c6c7.png] 

Option 2) BCD

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e425373876fe62dc2783bf41a83c855a99445b1261096e36e7f3923e132e7862.png] 

Option 3) RST

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/81229cfe5d787a294c18145960aa6464a9f709366bc14803f5460a57e68b5678.png] 

Option 4) JKL

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a6cd79c6f6ed734f15a36ad6997ea5c524d15dddfe60af24f49cd44edaec91f.png] 

Thus, out of all the options, 'ONM' is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
